source_claim: AlphaEvolve improves candidates by continuously receiving feedback from one or more evaluators, with optional cascades and generated feedback layered around the user-provided evaluation function; paper-ready evidence must distinguish the primary evaluator contract from optional post-evaluator LLM feedback and trace that feedback through the evolutionary loop
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has local evaluator/cascade/feedback arbitration metadata plus local oracle source refs and hashes when available, but does not claim AlphaEvolve-style candidate-level oracle lineage, per-generation feedback traces, primary evaluator contract proof, independent evaluator-oracle evidence with reference or statistical oracles, benchmark sufficiency proof, independent disagreement outcomes affecting validity, score reporting, database admission, or cross-run oracle tables.
